The '''Mission to Dathomir''' was an operation carried out during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
With the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the run, [[X2]] and the rest of [[Grey Squadron]] set out to the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] with the stated goal of investigating the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|Imperial prison]] on the world. Privately, however, X2&mdash;who was still growing acclimated to his ability to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]&mdash;acknowledged to his unit that his aim was to pursue his genetic brother [[X1]], whom he sensed was involved in something untoward within the walls of the facility.

==The Mission==
{{Quote|Imperials and Sith&hellip; Can this place get any worse?|Shara, upon encountering Nightsisters at the Imperial prison|<ref name="Elite" />}}
Grey Squadron was forced to infiltrate the prison by [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] through the dense foliage of the surrounding jungle. They were attacked by Imperial troopers on speeder bikes and were forced to drive through a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] burial ground. On reaching the outer gates, X2 and [[Shara]] made a surprising discovery: a contingent of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] fighting against both Grey Squadron and the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] within the outpost. Realizing the tactical advantage this presented, X2 and Shara split from the rest of Grey Squadron and pushed deeper into the grounds of the outpost. They quickly reunited with their allies at the entrance to the main building, at which point X2 began to sense something resonating powerfully with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] inside. Against Shara's wishes, he continued into the facility alone.

Within the bowels of the prison, X2 encountered the source of the disturbance: an enormous rancor being riden by the [[Nightsister Matriarch|leader]] of the Nightsister assault. Calling on the Force for aid, X2 repeatedly used [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force push]] on nearby rubble to knock the beast off balance, finishing it off with judicious use of his lightsaber. Once the rancor fell, the Nightsister Matriarch drew her lightsaber and attacked X2 on foot, but the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] bested her in a duel.

The disturbance quelled, X2 and some of his squad members forged their way further into the prison's depths. After fending off several more Imperial ambushes, the group finally discovered X1's secret: a cloning facility, complete with [[cloning tank]]s filled with what appeared to be early-stage [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] clones. Unfortunately for Grey Squadron, X1 was not in the facility; however, X2 soon located his brother's private office in an adjoining room, and with Shara's assistance the unit was able to obtain a complete copy of his personal files.

[[File:Dathomir_Star_Destroyer_BES.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] explodes.]]
Upon returning to their ships, X2 and Shara were greeted by a grim sight: an [[Unidentified Imperial saboteur|Imperial saboteur]] had managed to slip [[Detonation pack|detpacks]] into several of them, resulting in the destruction of numerous [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and the loss of many members of Grey Squadron. As X2 attempted to console one of the dying men, the remaining soldiers brought the captured Imperial before their distraught [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. Overcome with grief, X2 grasped the man with a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choke]] and threatened his life, nearly giving in to his anger and falling to the Dark Side. Before he could do so, though, Shara interjected herself, reminding X2 that he must not follow his brother's path of vengeance. Chastened by his brush with the Dark Side, X2 let the humbled Imperial go, ordering his squadron to launch what ships were left and flee the planet.

In space, the survivors encountered an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. Unable to make their escape, X2 ordered the remnants of his squadron to attack the vessel, vowing never to run from the Imperials again. During the subsequent fight X2 successfully maneuvered his X-wing through numerous waves of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], ultimately destroying the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship's]] bridge with several well-placed shots. The resulting explosion then detonated the rest of the Destroyer.

==Aftermath==
By mining the information gleaned from X1's personal data, X2 was able to discover the location of his brother's stronghold on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Though upset by the events on Dathomir, he vowed to find the resolve to finish the fight with his brother once and for all.
